nameplates clear resident head and upper body
nameplates remain visually anchored to their resident
manual resident-group recenter without implicit follow

description: Verifies the React-based public observer mounts successfully, loads the real C++ LifeLensCore runtime, and creates a world rather than using fake browser data.
steps: Open the public preview directly and verify observer startup does not depend on a separately fetched observer-engine JavaScript chunk
Wait for the status badge to leave Core loading…
Verify a stalled same-origin runtime request cannot leave the UI in Core loading… indefinitely
Verify an older Core runtime without dynamicEnvironmentJson does not crash the observer and only disables weather projection
Wait for the status badge to show Core 연결됨
Tap 새 월드 with no Seed entry and verify Core reports a generated WorldSeed
Open Seed로 동일한 월드 재현, enter 12345, and create that world
Verify the resident cards represent both authoritative Core sexes as 남성 and 여성
Observe all four founders through several automatic simulation refreshes and verify none blink out between refreshes
On mobile, verify the initial camera opens on the local inhabited area rather than fitting the entire terrain window into a miniature island
Pinch or wheel through multiple zoom levels and verify resident bodies stay proportionate to the terrain instead of remaining fixed-size
At wide zoom verify forests read as canopy masses rather than hundreds of dot-like tree markers
At close zoom compare a resident against nearby mature trees and verify the resident no longer reads as taller than the vegetation
Tap a visible resident without dragging and verify that resident becomes the focused life
Open a resident with sanitation/social/civilization memories or beliefs and verify user-facing text is Korean while Core raw semantics remain unchanged
Open 관찰 정보 and verify 주요 사건 shows recent event rows with resident, Korean event type, simulation day/time, and related resident names when present rather than a count alone
On Android drag with one finger and verify orbit yaw/elevation changes without selecting a resident
On Android move two fingers together and verify the observer pans across terrain; continue across a chunk boundary and verify authoritative terrain/weather query center follows the observer
On Android pinch to zoom and verify distance remains clamped
On desktop right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, wheel to zoom, and left-click to select
Tap 현재 주민 위치로 돌아가기 and verify the observer recenters once on the resident group without continuing to follow them
Observe a resident whose authoritative presentation phase remains Moving between Core refreshes and verify the walk loop stays active without moving beyond the latest Core position
Observe residents walking in several compass directions and verify the visible body faces the same direction as authoritative travel rather than moonwalking backward
Observe repeated one-cell locomotion across Core refresh boundaries and verify the gait cycle does not restart or drop to idle between consecutive movement snapshots
Observe a Social Avoid action near another resident and verify it never maps to the talking animation

Observe a target-backed Social, Parenting, KnowledgeTeaching, Civilization, or Physical interaction and verify the resident turns toward the authoritative target resident/grid without changing simulation position
Observe residents during Physical/Social/Civilization/Parenting/KnowledgeTeaching actions and verify concise Korean action bubbles reflect Core-owned intent and targets without inventing dialogue
Advance civilization until a facility is planned/built and verify its real Core grid site appears in-world with visible construction/operation state
Trigger outdoor toilet use and verify human-waste contamination appears at the authoritative Core location; verify sanitation sites appear when Core creates them
Observe completed social events and verify 사람들 사이 shows actor, target, Korean event type, time and intensity
Observe two residents in an active social/teaching/parenting interaction and verify a subtle world-space link makes the pairing legible without inventing dialogue
Verify action bubbles remain compact and visually subordinate to residents and the world
Select a resident and verify contact shadow plus a subtle pulsing focus ring improve grounding and selection readability
During Core Rain precipitation, verify visible elongated rain streaks remain around the active camera target after panning/recentering and become denser with precipitation intensity
During Core Snow precipitation, verify larger flakes fall slowly with wind drift and remain visible around the active camera target
Verify rain increases visible wet-surface response while snow visibly brightens terrain and exposed facility surfaces without changing Core state
Observe Eat/Drink/Wash/Sleep/UseToilet presentation with a Core target grid and verify a subtle resident-to-target line appears only when the target grid exists
Observe the same physical action without a Core target grid and verify Web does not invent a target line or target location
Zoom out to overview and verify ordinary action bubbles/links hide while the selected resident can keep its status; zoom back in and verify contextual overlays return
expected: The status must leave the loading state within the runtime timeout window; major life events expose recent authoritative event details instead of only a count, memory/belief/location strings are presented in Korean without changing Core-owned raw state; a missing optional weather binding must not fail LifeLensCore startup; if same-origin runtime delivery stalls, GitHub raw fallback is attempted, and the status shows Core 연결됨 before WorldSeed 12345 is created with living resident count 4, all four resident cards and 3D residents remain continuously visible without one-refresh disappearance/reappearance, the founder cards expose authoritative Core sex values and the terrain shows visually distinct male and female 3D residents with different skinned body geometry, garment silhouettes, deterministic clothing, proportions, and head-locked hair while remaining map-scale and clustered near their authoritative Core positions with readable labels. Resident body size and separation change with the same world zoom as the terrain while labels remain readable but visually subordinate, mobile opens focused on the inhabited local area instead of a tiny full-window diorama, wide-zoom forests merge into canopy masses instead of dot noise, open water does not expose a debug tile grid, mature trees read several times taller than a resident at comparable depth rather than as miniature props, a short tap on a Three World resident ray-picks that resident by GUID, shows a subtle focus ring and opens focused-life details backed by authoritative Core emotion, needs, personality/traits, directional relationships, family, memories, and beliefs without confusing camera drags for taps, movement between authoritative Core positions is visually capped by a world-units-per-second locomotion budget instead of distance-proportional teleport-like lerp, observer-center chunk changes shift resident current/target coordinates together so coordinate-origin movement is never mistaken for resident locomotion, movement uses walking animation, unsupported or contextless interaction activities fall back to neutral idle instead of inventing sitting/tool-use context, target-backed nearby Talk may use talking animation, resident animation phases are visibly desynchronized, and compact fallback markers appear only while the 3D asset is still loading or if it fails. Resident labels avoid actor/label overlap while staying close to their resident; displaced labels use a subtle leader line instead of floating ambiguously. While Core reports an active Moving presentation phase, the visible resident faces the same direction as authoritative travel and the walk loop remains visually continuous across snapshot refreshes without extrapolating beyond the latest authoritative Core position. Consecutive movement snapshots preserve gait phase instead of repeatedly restarting the walk clip. Social Avoid never maps to the talking animation. Target-backed interactions face the authoritative resident or Core target grid while stationary; presentation rotation never invents a target or changes Core position, and Social Avoid does not turn into an interaction-facing pose. Core-owned facilities, construction state, sanitation sites and human-waste residues are visible at their authoritative world positions; active resident actions are summarized in concise Korean speech/status bubbles, and recent structured social events are visible in the observer feed without synthesizing dialogue text. Active interpersonal actions are visually paired by a subtle connection line, compact status bubbles no longer dominate the frame, residents remain grounded with contact shadows, and selection uses a restrained pulse rather than oversized UI. Facilities visually read as wood/stone/fiber constructions rather than abstract boxes, resource nodes resemble natural material clusters instead of debug rings, sanitation and contamination marks integrate with the ground, and active fire/furnace light has subtle deterministic presentation flicker. Core Rain is visually obvious as elongated camera-centered falling streaks rather than tiny point particles; Core Snow uses larger slow drifting flakes, and both precipitation modes visibly affect ground/facility surface appearance while following camera activity framing. Core-backed Physical target grids may be visualized by subtle action links, but missing targets never produce invented coordinates. Wide zoom suppresses ordinary action overlays while preserving selected-resident context and restores them at local observation zoom.

name: Advance simulation time with canonical observer speeds
covers: 8 real minutes per simulation day at 1x
description: Verifies LifeLens uses the canonical time contract: continuous Core time, 1x = 8 real minutes per simulation day, and observer speed presets 0x/1x/4x/16x/64x without manual minute/hour jumps.
steps: Create WorldSeed 42 and read the Day/time label
Observe the Day/time label at 1x and verify it advances continuously
Select 4x, 16x and 64x and verify the same Core timeline advances progressively faster without discrete time jumps
Select pause and verify Core time stops while the world remains inspectable
Return to 1x, background the browser tab briefly, return to it, and verify catch-up remains bounded
expected: At 1x one LifeLens day targets 8 real minutes; 4x targets 2 minutes/day, 16x targets 30 seconds/day, and 64x targets 7.5 seconds/day. Pause stops Core advancement without disabling observation. Rendering remains decoupled from Core time, browser-throttle catch-up is bounded, and no +10 minute/+1 hour discrete jump controls remain.

name: Move observer across deterministic terrain
covers: vegetation grounded to the shared Core elevation sampler
understory shrubs and rocks from Core ecology coverage
terrain vertex color blending without chunk bands
resident selection without forced camera movement
procedural fallback when photoreal pack is unavailable
description: Verifies moving the observer asks Core for a different logical terrain/ecology window without creating fake terrain or resources.
steps: Create WorldSeed 42
Read the Biome badge above the terrain canvas
Drag the world across multiple chunk boundaries and inspect the terrain canvas
Observe the weather badge and verify temperature/weather summary are present
Increase observer speed and verify weather changes remain driven by Core simulation state rather than random browser effects
Inspect forested terrain and verify trees use layered irregular crowns with varied mature scale instead of identical cones
Inspect shrub/rock-rich chunks and verify understory density follows Core ecology coverage without debug markers
Pan across chunk boundaries and verify terrain tone variation is continuous enough that square color bands do not dominate the landscape
Observe rain/snow and night transitions and verify terrain material response plus moon/hemisphere light preserve readable silhouettes
Zoom into local terrain and verify short grass, pebbles, small rocks and deadwood fill the scale gap between terrain and large vegetation without forming a uniform carpet
Compare slopes, wet areas, forest floor and rock-rich chunks and verify ground detail distribution changes from Core ecology/moisture/slope rather than using one universal density
Deplete Wood/Fiber/PlantFood/Stone/Clay resources and verify nearby decorative detail thins or changes without restoring the untouched baseline at zero quantity
Zoom out and verify tiny grass/pebble/stump detail is progressively culled while forest mass and major terrain remain readable
Inspect multiple ecology regions and verify tree silhouettes mix broadleaf, conifer-like and sapling forms deterministically from Core biome/elevation/moisture context
Select a resident and verify selection alone highlights the resident without moving the camera; use the explicit recenter control and verify framing changes only then
At near zoom, verify the optional same-origin photoreal boulder/shrub/stump accents appear only after their manifest/assets load and do not replace the procedural fallback mass
Block or remove the photoreal nature pack and verify terrain, vegetation, rocks and depletion stumps remain visible via procedural fallback without a blank world
Zoom out below the photoreal threshold and verify photoreal accents hide while procedural mid/far nature remains readable
Inspect DEV Three diagnostics and verify photoreal accent instance counts are bounded by the configured per-asset triangle budgets rather than increasing with every visible chunk
Move from forest interior toward a low-forest neighbor and verify the edge gains shrubs and broader/asymmetric crowns while the interior remains denser and more vertical
At close zoom in a forested non-wetland area verify irregular leaf/litter clusters fill some bare ground without creating a uniform carpet; verify the litter disappears at wider zoom
Inspect an authoritative HumanWaste residue area and verify surrounding short ground cover thins according to residue intensity/radius while the residue itself remains Core-owned

Inspect DEV diagnostics while ground detail is visible and verify the ground-detail implementation remains bounded to six repeated-instanced material groups rather than spawning one draw call per prop
expected: Panning across chunk boundaries changes the observer-centered Core terrain/environment query window without changing simulation authority. The biome overlay reports Core biome/forest coverage, and deterministic terrain is rendered only from Core-provided elevation as one connected surface with authoritative slopes, non-rectangular river or stream paths where hydrology exists, with at most two flow exits per river/stream chunk, no synthetic cross-grid fallback channels, and minor streams/springs progressively hidden at wider zoom levels, and clustered vegetation rather than a debug-like tile grid. The world overlay exposes the authoritative Core weather summary and temperature; cloud, precipitation, visibility and wind alter Three World atmosphere and rain/snow presentation from the same Core state. Vegetation reads as layered mature woodland with understory and rocks rather than repeated cone props; terrain uses subtle vertex-level ecology/elevation variation so chunk color bands are visually suppressed, rain produces a modest wet-surface response, and nighttime remains dark but readable rather than collapsing into near-black. Near view also contains deterministic clustered short grass, pebbles, small rocks and deadwood placed from Core ecology/moisture/slope with facility/resource clearings; tiny detail culls at wider zoom while forest mass remains. Tree silhouettes vary by Core biome/elevation/moisture without changing simulation truth. Resident selection never forces a camera jump; explicit recenter performs a one-shot group framing. Optional photoreal boulder/shrub/stump accents are lazy, same-origin, near-only and triangle-budgeted; failure to load them never removes the procedural fallback world or changes Core truth. Forest floor detail includes a bounded sixth instanced litter layer, forest edges differ visibly from interiors through Core-neighbor coverage, and authoritative waste residue reduces nearby decorative ground cover without inventing simulation contamination.

covers: 48px mobile touch targets and safe-area padding
description: Verifies normal NEW GAME follows the canonical contract: users do not need to provide a Seed, while explicit Seed entry remains available only as a secondary deterministic replay affordance.
steps: Wait for Core 연결됨
Tap 새 월드 without opening the Seed replay section
Verify the observer creates a world with a non-empty generated WorldSeed
Verify primary user-facing labels are Korean and mobile controls have usable touch targets inside safe areas
expected: A new deterministic world is created from an automatically generated WorldSeed. Seed entry is secondary replay/developer UI, not a requirement for normal New Game. User-facing observer labels default to Korean and mobile touch chrome respects the 48px/safe-area contract.
